dimensions.name: Institutional Trust
dimensions.description: Measures the leader's ability to build and maintain trust in partnerships where institutional frameworks differ

dimensions.name: Relationship Velocity
dimensions.description: Measures the speed and quality with which a leader can build working trust in cross-border relationships

dimensions.name: Normative Flexibility
dimensions.description: Measures the leader's ability to identify, adapt to, and operate within unstated normative expectations

dimensions.name: Conflict Resolution
dimensions.description: Measures the leader's ability to diagnose and resolve partnership conflict by distinguishing between interpersonal friction, governance misalignment, and capability asymmetry

archetypes.name: The Institutional Strategist
archetypes.description: Reads institutional environments deeply while building relationships at speed.

archetypes.name: The Deep Connector
archetypes.description: Builds trust quickly and adapts seamlessly to different normative environments.

archetypes.name: The Normative Bridge
archetypes.description: Reads unstated expectations across cultures and resolves conflicts arising from normative misalignment.

archetypes.name: The Capability Broker
archetypes.description: Understands institutional dynamics deeply and resolves capability asymmetry conflicts effectively.

archetypes.name: The Relationship Specialist
archetypes.description: Builds trust quickly but may lack the institutional or normative depth for complex environments.

archetypes.name: The Institutional Analyst
archetypes.description: Deep understanding of institutional dynamics but slower to build relationships or adapt normatively.
